title: Bram and the Salt
author: August Coldharbour
blurb: Cyrus Thackeray, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
